title: validoria-mcp
description: Continuous website testing by Validoria — monitor security, SEO, performance, and accessibility.
summary: Continuous website testing by Validoria — monitor security, SEO, performance, and accessibility.
offersHint: Continuous website testing by Validoria — monitor security, SEO, performance, and accessibility. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.teste.no/api/mcp · Packages: npm:validoria-mcp · Env vars: TESTE_NO_API_KEY, TESTE_NO_API_URL

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Teste.no API token (Settings → API Keys). Prefix: tno_

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Override only for self-hosted instances.

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Teste.no API token (Settings → API Keys). Prefix: tno_

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Override only for self-hosted instances.

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Teste.no API token (Settings → API Keys). Prefix: tno_

environmentVariables.name: TESTE_NO_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Override only for self-hosted instances.

toolsPreview.name: guest_start_scan
toolsPreview.description: Run a free 6-test HTTP scan against a public URL without an API key. Rate-limited (5/IP/hour, 3/session/day). Returns scanId — poll with guest_get_scan. For continuous monitoring, sign up free and use create_target. See teste-no://docs/quickstart.

toolsPreview.name: guest_get_scan
toolsPreview.description: Poll results for a guest_start_scan. Pass the scanId and guestSessionId from the start response. No API key required.

toolsPreview.name: list_targets
toolsPreview.description: List all monitoring targets for your team. Returns name, URL, type, status, and uptime info for each target.

toolsPreview.name: get_target
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed information about a specific target including status, uptime, fingerprint, and composite scores.

toolsPreview.name: get_target_scores
toolsPreview.description: Get composite scores (Security, SEO, Performance, Accessibility) for a target. Each score is 0-100 with a status rating.

toolsPreview.name: list_findings
toolsPreview.description: List findings (discovered issues) across your targets. Filter by status, severity, or target. Returns title, severity, status, test name, and AI enrichment if available.

toolsPreview.name: get_finding
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific finding, including evidence, AI analysis, and recommended fix.

toolsPreview.name: list_incidents
toolsPreview.description: List incidents (grouped operational issues) across your targets. Filter by status. Returns title, severity, status, findings count, and deployment correlation.

toolsPreview.name: get_incident
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific incident including linked findings, AI analysis, and deployment correlation.

toolsPreview.name: list_runs
toolsPreview.description: List recent test runs. Filter by target, status, or test slug. Returns run status, score, summary, duration, and finding count.

toolsPreview.name: get_run
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific test run including metrics, score, summary, errors, and associated findings.

toolsPreview.name: active_runs
toolsPreview.description: Get currently running and queued tests across all targets. Useful for checking what tests are in progress right now.

toolsPreview.name: team_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get team-wide overview statistics: total runs, pass rate, open findings, open incidents, average duration. Supports lifetime, monthly, or weekly periods.

toolsPreview.name: target_stats
toolsPreview.description: Get statistics for a specific target: runs, pass rate, findings, duration. Supports lifetime, monthly, or weekly periods.

toolsPreview.name: daily_trends
toolsPreview.description: Get daily time-series data for runs, findings, and average duration. Useful for identifying trends over time. Returns up to 90 days of data.

toolsPreview.name: get_site_map
toolsPreview.description: Get the latest crawl snapshot for a target. Returns page inventory stats, SEO issues, broken pages/assets, response times, and a diff against the previous crawl. Optionally include page-level details.

toolsPreview.name: list_maintenance_windows
toolsPreview.description: List maintenance windows for a target. Shows scheduled and recurring maintenance periods that suppress alerts.

toolsPreview.name: list_tests
toolsPreview.description: List all available test definitions (plugins). Shows slug, name, category, runner type, weight class, schedule, and enablement status. Useful for knowing which tests can be triggered.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_test
toolsPreview.description: Run a specific test against a target. Specify either the test definition ID or slug. The test is queued and executed asynchronously — use get_run to check status.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_all_tests
toolsPreview.description: Run all enabled tests against a target as a scan workflow. All tests in the target's test profile are queued. Returns the workflow ID and list of queued runs.

toolsPreview.name: acknowledge_incident
toolsPreview.description: Acknowledge an open incident to signal that someone is looking at it. Changes status from OPEN to ACKNOWLEDGED.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_incident
toolsPreview.description: Resolve an incident to mark it as handled. Changes status to RESOLVED and sets the closed timestamp.

toolsPreview.name: mute_finding
toolsPreview.description: Mute an open finding to suppress it from dashboards and alerts. Status changes from OPEN to MUTED.

toolsPreview.name: create_maintenance_window
toolsPreview.description: Schedule a maintenance window for a target. During maintenance, alerts and notifications are suppressed. Supports one-time, daily, and weekly recurring windows.

toolsPreview.name: delete_maintenance_window
toolsPreview.description: Remove a scheduled maintenance window.

toolsPreview.name: record_deployment
toolsPreview.description: Record a deployment event for a target. Deployments are auto-correlated with incidents created within 20 minutes. Useful for tracking releases and root-cause analysis.

toolsPreview.name: recompute_scores
toolsPreview.description: Force recompute all composite scores (Security, SEO, Performance, Accessibility) for a target. Useful after manual changes or when scores seem stale.

toolsPreview.name: list_automation_rules
toolsPreview.description: List all automation rules for the team. Rules automatically react to events (test failures, incidents, downtime) with configurable actions (escalate severity, suppress, rerun, webhook, notify).

toolsPreview.name: get_automation_rule
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific automation rule.

toolsPreview.name: create_automation_rule
toolsPreview.description: Create an automation rule that reacts to events. Triggers: TEST_FAILED, TEST_RECOVERED, INCIDENT_CREATED, INCIDENT_RESOLVED, TARGET_DOWN, TARGET_RECOVERED. Actions: escalate (change severity), suppress (mute), rerun (schedule retry), notify, webhook, add_note.

toolsPreview.name: update_automation_rule
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing automation rule. Any field not provided will remain unchanged.

toolsPreview.name: delete_automation_rule
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete an automation rule.

toolsPreview.name: list_journeys
toolsPreview.description: List custom browser test flows (journeys) for a target or all team targets. Journeys are multi-step Playwright tests that verify user flows like checkout, login, and search.

toolsPreview.name: get_journey
toolsPreview.description: Get full details of a specific journey including all steps.

toolsPreview.name: create_journey
toolsPreview.description: Create a custom browser test flow for a target. Steps are executed sequentially in a Playwright browser. Supports actions: navigate, click, type, fill, select, assert, wait, screenshot, scroll, hover, use_fragment. Variables like {{LOGIN_EMAIL}} are resolved from the target secrets vault.

toolsPreview.name: update_journey
toolsPreview.description: Update a journey's name, settings, or steps. When steps are provided, all existing steps are replaced.

toolsPreview.name: delete_journey
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a journey and all its steps.

toolsPreview.name: trigger_journey
toolsPreview.description: Execute a journey (custom browser test flow) against its target. The journey runs asynchronously — use get_run to check progress.

toolsPreview.name: list_scheduled_reports
toolsPreview.description: List all scheduled reports for the team. Reports are automatically generated and emailed on a daily or weekly basis.

toolsPreview.name: create_scheduled_report
toolsPreview.description: Create a new scheduled email report. Reports include run stats, open findings, composite scores, and per-target status.

toolsPreview.name: update_scheduled_report
toolsPreview.description: Update an existing scheduled report. Any field not provided stays unchanged.

toolsPreview.name: delete_scheduled_report
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a scheduled report.

toolsPreview.name: get_team_settings
toolsPreview.description: Get the team's configuration including AI enrichment, uptime monitoring, severity escalation, run policies, notification coalescing, SEO, and Kloner Tasks integration settings.

toolsPreview.name: update_team_settings
toolsPreview.description: Update team configuration. All fields are optional — only provided fields are changed. Covers: AI enrichment (model, temperature, auto-enrich, spending cap), uptime (timeout, thresholds), severity escalation (recurrence/age triggers), run policies (concurrency, timeouts), SEO (rank tracking, keyword strategy), notification coalescing (digest), and the kill switch (testsPaused).

toolsPreview.name: list_notification_rules
toolsPreview.description: List all notification alert rules for the team. Rules map event types + severity levels to notification channels.

toolsPreview.name: create_notification_rule
toolsPreview.description: Create a notification alert rule. Defines which events at which severity levels trigger notifications on which channels. Supports quiet hours and per-target scoping.

toolsPreview.name: update_notification_rule
toolsPreview.description: Update a notification rule. Only provided fields are changed.

toolsPreview.name: delete_notification_rule
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a notification rule.

toolsPreview.name: list_notification_channels
toolsPreview.description: List all notification channels (Email, Slack, Webhook, SMS, Web Push) configured for the team. Sensitive config values are redacted.

toolsPreview.name: list_keywords
toolsPreview.description: List all SEO keywords tracked for a target, including latest Google rank position. Max 50 per target.

toolsPreview.name: add_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Add an SEO keyword to track for a target. Max 50 keywords per target.

toolsPreview.name: remove_keyword
toolsPreview.description: Remove an SEO keyword from a target.

toolsPreview.name: start_load_test
toolsPreview.description: Start a load test against a target. Max 100 concurrent connections, max 5 min duration, 1 test at a time per target, 60s cooldown between tests. Modes: HTTP_FLOOD (autocannon), BROWSER_USERS (Playwright), COMBINED (both). OWNER/ADMIN only.

toolsPreview.name: cancel_load_test
toolsPreview.description: Cancel a running load test.

toolsPreview.name: get_load_test
toolsPreview.description: Get details and results of a load test run.

toolsPreview.name: list_load_tests
toolsPreview.description: List recent load test runs for a target.

toolsPreview.name: list_secrets
toolsPreview.description: List secrets stored in a target's vault. Values are masked — only key names and labels are shown. Secrets are used by test plugins (e.g. LOGIN_EMAIL, LOGIN_PASSWORD for B2B shops, ga4_service_account for GA4).

toolsPreview.name: store_secret
toolsPreview.description: Store an encrypted secret in a target's vault. Common keys: LOGIN_EMAIL, LOGIN_PASSWORD (B2B shop auth), ga4_service_account (GA4 monitoring). Values are AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest.

toolsPreview.name: rotate_secret
toolsPreview.description: Update the value of an existing secret.

toolsPreview.name: delete_secret
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a secret from a target's vault.

toolsPreview.name: list_page_fragments
toolsPreview.description: List all reusable page fragments for the team. Fragments are shared step sequences (e.g. "Login", "Dismiss Cookies") that can be inserted into multiple Journeys via the use_fragment action.

toolsPreview.name: create_page_fragment
toolsPreview.description: Create a reusable step sequence that can be shared across multiple Journeys. Fragment names must be unique per team.

toolsPreview.name: update_page_fragment
toolsPreview.description: Update a page fragment. When steps are provided, all existing steps are replaced.

toolsPreview.name: delete_page_fragment
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a page fragment.

toolsPreview.name: create_target
toolsPreview.description: Add a new website, API, or webshop target for monitoring with full onboarding. Automatically enables compatible tests, triggers an initial scan, and captures a page screenshot. Requires write scope (Free plan: 1 target). Use analyze_target first to detect platform and get test recommendations.

toolsPreview.name: update_target
toolsPreview.description: Update a target's properties (name, URL, type, environment, business weight, tags, uptime toggle).

toolsPreview.name: delete_target
toolsPreview.description: Permanently delete a target and all its associated data (runs, findings, incidents, artifacts). This cannot be undone.

toolsPreview.name: analyze_target
toolsPreview.description: Fingerprint a URL and get test recommendations before creating a target. Detects platform (Shopify, WordPress, etc.), CDN, server stack, frontend framework, analytics, and B2B/ecommerce signals. Returns recommended tests with explanations. Use this before create_target to know what type to assign and which tests will be enabled.

toolsPreview.name: import_targets
toolsPreview.description: Bulk import up to 100 websites for monitoring. Each URL gets a target created with auto-enabled tests, initial scan, and screenshot capture. Partial success — failed URLs are reported individually without blocking others.

toolsPreview.name: create_muting_rule
toolsPreview.description: Create a rule to auto-mute findings matching a pattern. Existing open findings matching the rule are muted immediately. Supports muting by fingerprint pattern, test definition, or test+target combination.

toolsPreview.name: system_health
toolsPreview.description: Get a comprehensive system health report: BullMQ queue depths, active/stuck runs, user sessions, notification delivery stats, and recent error counts. Requires admin scope.

toolsPreview.name: update_test
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable a test definition globally, or update its schedule/timeout. Requires admin scope.

toolsPreview.name: enable_all_tests
toolsPreview.description: Enable all test definitions globally. Optionally filter by category to only enable tests in that category. Requires admin scope.

toolsPreview.name: disable_all_tests
toolsPreview.description: Disable all test definitions globally. Optionally filter by category to only disable tests in that category. Requires admin scope.
